description: This file defines an abstract base class for Voice Activity Detection (VAD) analysis, including related data structures, states, and utility methods. It provides a framework for implementing VAD algorithms with configurable parameters, state management, and audio processing, intended for subclasses to implement specific confidence calculation logic.

classes.name: VADState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible voice activity detection states: QUIET, STARTING, SPEAKING, STOPPING.

classes.name: VADParams
classes.description: Data class for VAD configuration parameters including confidence threshold, start/stop durations, and minimum volume.

classes.name: VADAnalyzer
classes.description: Abstract base class providing the framework for VAD analysis, including state management, parameter setting, and audio buffer processing.

methods.name: num_frames_required
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the number of audio frames needed for analysis.

methods.name: voice_confidence
methods.description: Abstract method to compute voice activity confidence score from an audio buffer.

methods.name: set_sample_rate
methods.description: Set the sample rate for audio processing and recalculate internal parameters.

methods.name: set_params
methods.description: Update VAD parameters and recalculate related internal values.

methods.name: _get_smoothed_volume
methods.description: Calculate smoothed audio volume using exponential smoothing.

methods.name: analyze_audio
methods.description: Asynchronously analyze an audio buffer and return the current VAD state.

methods.name: _run_analyzer
methods.description: Process the audio buffer to update VAD state based on confidence and volume thresholds.
